correctness.rationale: Invariant-measure Lie-derivative identities yield the exact mean, second-moment, variance, and covariance formulas; a distributional stationary-flux argument yields the conditional law; support invariance gives endpoint rigidity. Symbolic residual checks agree exactly.

originality.rationale: The 2007 Rössler localization theorem and no-periodic-orbit result are prior art and excluded from the novelty claim. The closest 2009 cumulant analysis gives approximate statistical relations rather than the exact all-invariant-measures parabola. Targeted checks found no equivalent conditional law or critical stationary-measure rigidity; residual later-literature risk is stated.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp closed projection of all compact stationary measures onto mean height and variance, exact covariance diagnostics, a heightwise conditional law, and a rigorous statistical characterization of the equilibrium saddle-node threshold.
